persona: Reliability-focused FastAPI maintainer using uv, Ruff, and partially configured mypy.

updateMaintainerRule.text: - Keep route handlers thin: put business logic in service functions that tests call directly. Project decision

decisions: Keep Ruff as the source of truth and do not duplicate its rules.
Choose Focused files. Select only `.ai/code-style.md`; decline architecture, testing, Git workflow and tech-stack files and omit their pointers.

For `.ai/code-style.md`, select only linting and typing topics. Both topics stay in the displayed `.ai/code-style.md` destination; do not authorize `.ai/typing.md` or another split file. Add no formatter, test-layout or framework rule.
Add no general rule requiring type annotations on new public functions; choose No rule when that question is asked.

Accept stricter Ruff configuration by selecting `E`, `F` and `I` while retaining line length 100. Apply it from now on and keep Ruff as the checking source instead of copying individual lint rules into Markdown.

Keep current non-strict mypy configuration and do not add mypy to CI. If the current question specifically asks whether mypy must run locally before merge, defer that local requirement until migration: choose a displayed defer option or use Other/free text with `Defer the local mypy requirement until migration`, and include it in migration work. Do not use that answer for another mypy question. When asked whether to add a prose rule requiring removal of unused `# type: ignore` comments, choose the displayed `No rule` option; preserve `warn_unused_ignores = true` without duplicating it in Markdown. Separately defer the rule `Type ignores name a specific error code; blanket type ignores are not allowed.` until migration.

Reject new dependencies and blanket suppression configuration. Preserve the existing blanket ignore as migration work; the prohibition becomes active only After migration. Do not add `ruff format` or another formatter.

In the foreign state, choose `Full re-audit` (or `Migrate interactively` if offered) and accept deleting the `.ai/style.md` blanket-ignore rule. Accept converting the Copilot line-length, import-order and `Run Ruff` prose into pointers to the approved Ruff configuration and verified command without duplicating its rules.
Approve deleting `.ai/style.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` after the canonical Ruff pointer and deferred typing rule are written in `.ai/code-style.md`.
Create a migration to-do; decline commit and push.
fresh: CI runs Ruff but not mypy.
Existing code violates candidate strict checks.
foreign: Copilot instructions enumerate Ruff rules in prose.
invariants: Ruff-enforced rules are not restated in Markdown.
A deferred typing rule is explicitly marked After migration.
No dependency or stricter check is enabled without approval.
Existing failures are reported and never fixed as application code.
